evidence:
Authored product distinction is established by source comparison. Frozen task/instruction.md:1-7 centers Finance's saved two-to-four-member compensation transfers, fully committed cross-requisition cycles, history-sensitive stale previews and historical retry receipts; task.toml:5-15 describes the same recruiting/compensation domain and provenance. hireops_rules.md:101-192 defines equity intrinsic/annualized valuation, separate run-rate and approval basis and tiered approval; :221-273 preserves linked offer, signing, grant and referral histories; :421-480 makes complete-set headroom netting, economic-history freshness and original-receipt replay concrete. The implementation in solution/app/src/change-sets.js:38-64 nets release and replacement movements by requisition, :94-140 posts offer successors and signed payment/grant/history changes in one transaction. Functional judge.toml:906-947 and :987-1082 explicitly grade this domain behavior. Bounded sibling survey covered the available project instruction names and opening concepts, with deep comparisons against the closest sources: Pellmoor hiring-rules.md:3-25,27-66,69-121 and functional criteria concern stages, fresh panel assessments, vacancy-opening capacity, funnel history and ordered interview-to-offer batches; it treats reordered member IDs as a key mismatch (:106-113), whereas HireOps treats member ordering as the same compensation intent (rules:430-435). ExpenseFlow instruction.md:5-7 and its functional descriptions concern dated FX, capped expenses, reclaimable VAT, cost-center allocation and receipt rejection. UtiliBill instruction.md:5-11 and functional descriptions concern metered energy, tariff components, credit banks, corrections and remittances. These are distinct state machines and calculations, despite intentionally shared sign-in, append-only history, transaction and retry patterns. The available suite guidance explicitly allows shared infrastructure while requiring distinct domain behavior (NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:195-203), and the frozen template leaves product instruction/metadata empty. No nouns-swapped sibling was found.

Adversarial source checks: a renamed Pellmoor batch-offer desk that only reserves vacancy slots cannot satisfy HireOps' full-budget reciprocal transfer, signed bonus adjustment, replacement grant and original-referral-preservation criteria; a renamed ExpenseFlow split/rejection ledger cannot satisfy the separate approval basis, two vesting schedules and current committed offer lineage. Conversely, a conforming implementation may choose another layout, endpoint schema, generated identifiers and version representation: instruction.md:5,9 and rules:435,456 expressly permit those choices, and functional judge.toml:920,956,1019 avoids requiring golden naming. These are reasoned source counterexamples, not executed app grades.

Hashes: canonical input fingerprint and all 71 frozen manifest file hashes matched; current task/rules also matched. per-row-review/evidence/53/source-review.json records exact cited source and sibling hashes plus raw-index hash verification.
